summary: Blog with a sticky-style right sidebar: big title and lead, a single column of tall post cards (cover, category, title, excerpt, date, author) and a side column with search, categories and a year archive. Needs 10 to 15 posts and category names.

sections.note: no band: red H1 and a two-line lead over the post column

(measured as sidebar) left column (about 810 px): stacked post cards with a branded cover image, red category, grey title, two-line excerpt and a footer line with date and author; right column (about 390 px): search field, blog title and blurb, three social icons, a Categories list, then Posts by year as accordion rows
